summary: A job run that has stopped working can no longer hold an update back.

fixes.title: A stuck job run no longer holds updates
fixes.text: When a PIM Manager job run has gone on far longer than usual and written nothing since it started, the update stops that one run, tells Invardia support and goes ahead. A run that is still working is never stopped.

fixes.title: Clearer update log
fixes.text: The update log no longer says an installation is already on a new version while it still runs the previous one.
